notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Cast Infernal Plunge by paying {R} and sacrificing another creature.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Infernal Plunge.
Resolve the copy of Infernal Plunge, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Rootha from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
